%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = vars.supplier as String default "" var fromTs = (vars.fromDate as String default "") ++ " 00:00:00" var toTs = (vars.toDate as String default "") ++ " 00:00:00" --- "Select a.*, b.routeid from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.sales") ++ " as a left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.visits") ++ " as b on a.VisitID = b.visitid inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") ++ " as c on a.PRODUCT_ID = c.id and c.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "' where a.Created_AT between '" ++ fromTs ++ "' and '" ++ toTs ++ "' order by a.Entry_ID desc LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String)

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String var lim = " LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String) var sales = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.sales") var orders = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.orders") var visits = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.visits") var products = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") --- "Select a.*, b.userid, b.visit_frequency, b.visit_week, b.visit_day, b.status, d.saler_category from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.routes") ++ " as a " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.user.routes") ++ " as b on a.route_id = b.route_id " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.users") ++ " as c on b.userid = c.id " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.user.categories") ++ " as d on c.rep_category = d.usercategory " ++ "where exists (Select 1 from (Select distinct routeid from (" ++ "select Distinct v.routeid, y.product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ sales ++ " as y inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ visits ++ " as v on y.VisitID = v.visitid " ++ "union all select Distinct v.routeid, y.product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ orders ++ " as y inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ visits ++ " as v on y.Visit_ID = v.visitid" ++ ") as x inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ products ++ " as z on x.product_id = z.id where z.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "') as w where w.routeid = a.route_id) " ++ "order by a.route_id" ++ lim

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String var lim = " LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String) var sales = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.sales") var orders = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.orders") var products = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") --- "Select a.*, b.saler_category from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.users") ++ " as a " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.user.categories") ++ " as b on a.rep_category = b.usercategory " ++ "where exists (Select 1 from (Select distinct userid from (" ++ "select Distinct userid, y.product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ sales ++ " as y " ++ "union all select Distinct user_id as userid, y.product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ orders ++ " as y" ++ ") as x inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ products ++ " as z on x.product_id = z.id where z.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "') as w where w.userid = a.id) " ++ "order by a.id" ++ lim

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String var lim = " LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String) var sales = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.sales") var orders = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.orders") var products = p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") --- "Select a.* from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.customers") ++ " as a " ++ "where a.Customer_Type = 'Customer' " ++ "and exists (Select 1 from (Select distinct SHOPID from (" ++ "select Distinct SHOPID, product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ sales ++ " as y " ++ "union all select Distinct SHOP_ID as SHOPID, product_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ orders ++ " as y" ++ ") as x inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ products ++ " as z on x.product_id = z.id where z.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "') as w where w.SHOPID = a.SHOPID) " ++ "order by a.SHOPID" ++ lim

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String var lim = " LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String) --- "Select a.productcode, d.UOMName, b.stockpoint_name, MAX(b.date_created) as date_created, SUM(b.quantity) as quantity, SUM(b.total_cost) as total_cost from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") ++ " as a " ++ "inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.stock.movement") ++ " as b on a.id = b.product_id " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.uom.quantities") ++ " as c on b.product_id = c.product_id " ++ "left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.uom") ++ " as d on c.packaging_id = d.id " ++ "where a.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "' group by a.id, d.UOMName, b.stockpoint_name order by a.id, d.UOMName, b.stockpoint_name" ++ lim

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String var lim = " LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String) --- // EXISTS on stockpoint_id is commented until Solutech adds the column. "Select c.* from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.customers") ++ " as c " ++ "where c.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Supplier' " ++ "/* and exists (Select 1 from (select distinct stockpoint_id from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.products") ++ " as a " ++ "inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("sapi.mysql.sat.table.stock.movement") ++ " as b on a.id = b.product_id " ++ "where a.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "') as z where z.stockpoint_id = c.id) */ " ++ "order by c.SHOPID" ++ lim
